result.stdout:
Usage: dotnet ftp-deploy [options] [profile]

Options:
  -h, --help          Show this help message and exit.
  -c, --config <file> Specify the configuration file to use.
  -np, --no-progress  Disable progress output.
  -q, --quiet         Suppress all output except errors.
  -P, --parallel <n>  Set the number of parallel connections for file transfers (default: 1).
  -v, --verbose       Enable verbose output (overrides quiet mode).
  -K, --keep          Keep unknown remote files (non-interactive mode).
  -D, --delete        Delete unknown remote files (non-interactive mode).
